results.label: authorize: 302 to redirect_uri with a code and the state echoed
authorize: an unknown client_id is refused (≥ 400, no redirect)
token (authorization_code): the client's exchange_code_for_tokens parses the response
token: a used authorization code is refused
token response carries access_token, refresh_token, expires_in (int), scope, token_type Bearer
token: a wrong client_secret is refused
refresh: the client's refresh_access_token gets a new access AND refresh token (rotation)
refresh: a spent refresh token is refused
households: {"households": [{id, name}]} (primary key), non-empty, the client reads every one
households: one response — no pagination keys
accounts?household_id=: {"accounts": [{id, name}]} per household, one response

positions?account_id=: {"positions": [...]} with every T6 primary field (id, cusip, isin, ticker, name, asset_type, quantity, market_value, cost_basis, currency_code); decimals as numbers or decimal strings
transactions?account_id=: {"transactions": [...]} with every T7 primary field; type one of the client's 7
every transacted security also appears in the account's positions
every position and transaction carries an explicit id
every date is ISO YYYY-MM-DD
a resource without a valid Bearer token is refused 401
every simulator response carries X-Counterparty-Simulated: true
webhook: lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body, verified by the receiver's own verify_signature_source, body {event_id, event_type, account_id, environment}
no network: the run opened no socket outside the database
